hero.statement: No change was needed because the crab's hide threshold is written as ENERGY_MAX * 0.30, which stays correct after ENERGY_MAX was rescaled to 1.
My crab already uses ENERGY_MAX as a unit (hidden = energy < ENERGY_MAX * 0.3), so the rescale from 100 to 1 is automatically handled and no change was needed.
ENERGY_MAX changed from 100 to 1; I kept HIDE_BELOW as ENERGY_MAX * 0.3, so the threshold still means 30% regardless of the unit.
My code defines `HIDE_BELOW = ENERGY_MAX * 0.3` so the 30% threshold already follows the new `ENERGY_MAX = 1`; no changes were needed.

ENERGY_MAX changed to 1, so I kept DART_ENERGY as 0.05 * ENERGY_MAX so it still equals the requested 5% of max energy per dart.

The new shrimp does not depend on the magnitude of ENERGY_MAX; it uses ENERGY_MAX * 0.05 for a 5% dart cost, which remains correct after the ENERGY_MAX rescale.
